books.title: Pride and Prejudice
books.author: Jane Austen
books.description: Elizabeth Bennet navigates society, family pressures, and her complicated feelings for the proud Mr. Darcy in Regency England.

books.title: Moby-Dick; Or, The Whale
books.author: Herman Melville
books.description: Sailor Ishmael narrates Captain Ahab's obsessive quest to hunt down Moby Dick, a giant white sperm whale.

books.title: Frankenstein
books.author: Mary Shelley
books.description: A young scientist creates a living creature from dead body parts, leading to tragic consequences for both creator and creation.

books.title: Dracula
books.author: Bram Stoker
books.description: Count Dracula travels from Transylvania to England, and a group led by Professor Van Helsing must stop his reign of terror.

books.title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
books.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
books.description: Twelve short stories featuring the brilliant detective Sherlock Holmes and his companion Dr. Watson solving mysteries in Victorian London.

books.title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
books.author: Lewis Carroll
books.description: Young Alice falls down a rabbit hole into a fantastical world filled with peculiar creatures and nonsensical adventures.

books.title: The Great Gatsby
books.author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
books.description: Nick Carraway narrates the story of mysterious millionaire Jay Gatsby and his obsession with the beautiful Daisy Buchanan in 1920s New York.

books.title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
books.author: Oscar Wilde
books.description: A young man wishes his portrait would age instead of himself, allowing him to pursue a life of pleasure while remaining eternally youthful.

books.title: A Tale of Two Cities
books.author: Charles Dickens
books.description: Set during the French Revolution, the novel follows characters in London and Paris whose lives become intertwined through love, sacrifice, and redemption.

books.title: Jane Eyre
books.author: Charlotte Bronte
books.description: An orphaned governess falls in love with her mysterious employer Mr. Rochester, but dark secrets threaten their happiness.

books.title: Wuthering Heights
books.author: Emily Bronte
books.description: A tale of passionate and destructive love between Heathcliff and Catherine on the Yorkshire moors, spanning two generations.

books.title: Crime and Punishment
books.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
books.description: A poor student in St. Petersburg commits murder and struggles with guilt and paranoia while a detective closes in.

books.title: The Adventures of Tom Sawyer
books.author: Mark Twain
books.description: A mischievous boy growing up along the Mississippi River gets into adventures involving treasure, pirates, and a murder mystery.

books.title: Adventures of Huckleberry Finn
books.author: Mark Twain
books.description: Huck Finn escapes his abusive father and travels down the Mississippi River with Jim, an escaped slave seeking freedom.

books.title: War and Peace
books.author: Leo Tolstoy
books.description: An epic novel following Russian aristocratic families during the Napoleonic Wars, exploring love, war, and the meaning of history.

books.title: The Count of Monte Cristo
books.author: Alexandre Dumas
books.description: Wrongfully imprisoned sailor Edmond Dantes escapes, discovers a vast treasure, and returns to Paris to exact revenge on those who betrayed him.

books.title: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
books.author: L. Frank Baum
books.description: Dorothy and her dog Toto are swept from Kansas to Oz, where they join a Scarecrow, Tin Woodman, and Cowardly Lion on a journey to the Emerald City.

books.title: Treasure Island
books.author: Robert Louis Stevenson
books.description: Young Jim Hawkins discovers a pirate treasure map and embarks on a sea voyage filled with mutiny and adventure.

books.title: The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
books.author: Robert Louis Stevenson
books.description: A London lawyer investigates the connection between the respectable Dr. Jekyll and the evil Mr. Hyde, uncovering a disturbing secret.

books.title: Little Women
books.author: Louisa May Alcott
books.description: Four sisters grow up during the Civil War era, facing hardships, romance, and personal growth as they transition into adulthood.

books.title: Don Quixote
books.author: Miguel de Cervantes
books.description: A retired Spanish gentleman reads so many chivalric romances that he loses his sanity and decides to become a knight-errant, setting off on absurd adventures with his squire Sancho Panza.

books.title: The Odyssey
books.author: Homer
books.description: The Greek hero Odysseus struggles to return home to Ithaca after the fall of Troy, facing monsters, gods, and temptresses on his decade-long journey.

books.title: Hamlet
books.author: William Shakespeare
books.description: Prince Hamlet of Denmark seeks revenge against his uncle Claudius who has murdered his father and seized the throne, wrestling with doubt, madness, and mortality.

books.title: Romeo and Juliet
books.author: William Shakespeare
books.description: Two young lovers from feuding families in Verona fall passionately in love, but their families' hatred and a series of tragic misfortunes lead to disaster.

books.title: Macbeth
books.author: William Shakespeare
books.description: A Scottish general is spurred by supernatural prophecies and his ambitious wife to murder the king and seize the throne, with devastating consequences.

books.title: Gulliver's Travels
books.author: Jonathan Swift
books.description: Surgeon Lemuel Gulliver voyages to extraordinary lands inhabited by tiny people, giants, intelligent horses, and mad scientists in this satirical masterpiece.

books.title: Robinson Crusoe
books.author: Daniel Defoe
books.description: A castaway survives alone on a remote tropical island for decades, learning to fend for himself before encountering another human he names Friday.

books.title: Oliver Twist
books.author: Charles Dickens
books.description: An orphan boy escapes a workhouse and falls in with a gang of criminals in London, befriending the cunning Artful Dodger and the sinister Fagin.

books.title: Great Expectations
books.author: Charles Dickens
books.description: Young Pip rises from poverty to wealth with the help of a mysterious benefactor, discovering truths about class, loyalty, and what it means to be a gentleman.

books.title: David Copperfield
books.author: Charles Dickens
books.description: The semi-autobiographical story of David Copperfield from his troubled childhood through his growth into manhood, encountering memorable characters along the way.

books.title: Sense and Sensibility
books.author: Jane Austen
books.description: Two sisters with contrasting temperaments—sensible Elinor and passionate Marianne—navigate love and heartbreak in Regency-era England.

books.title: Emma
books.author: Jane Austen
books.description: A clever but misguided young woman in a small English village fancies herself a matchmaker, meddling in others' love lives with comic and painful results.

books.title: Northanger Abbey
books.author: Jane Austen
books.description: An innocent young woman obsessed with Gothic novels visits a real abbey, letting her imagination run wild as she suspects foul play where none exists.

books.title: Anna Karenina
books.author: Leo Tolstoy
books.description: A passionate affair between the married Anna Karenina and the dashing officer Vronsky tears through Russian high society with tragic consequences.

books.title: The Brothers Karamazov
books.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
books.description: Three brothers with vastly different personalities collide over faith, morality, and the murder of their corrupt father in Dostoevsky's final masterpiece.

books.title: Middlemarch
books.author: George Eliot
books.description: A panoramic study of English provincial life follows the idealistic Dorothea Brooke and the ambitious Dr. Lydgate as they pursue their dreams in a small Midlands town.

books.title: Tess of the d'Urbervilles
books.author: Thomas Hardy
books.description: A pure-hearted country girl is seduced and ruined, then falls in love with another man who cannot accept her past in this devastating critique of Victorian morality.

books.title: Far from the Madding Crowd
books.author: Thomas Hardy
books.description: The independent and beautiful Bathsheba Everdene attracts three very different suitors in rural Dorset, forcing her to choose between passion and reason.

books.title: Les Misérables
books.author: Victor Hugo
books.description: The story of ex-convict Jean Valjean's redemption and pursuit by the relentless Inspector Javert against the backdrop of post-Napoleonic France.

books.title: The Hunchback of Notre-Dame
books.author: Victor Hugo
books.description: The deformed bell-ringer Quasimodo falls in love with the beautiful Gypsy dancer Esmeralda in 15th-century Paris, but darker forces conspire against her.

books.title: Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea
books.author: Jules Verne
books.description: Professor Aronnax is captured by the mysterious Captain Nemo aboard the submarine Nautilus and taken on an extraordinary voyage beneath the oceans.

books.title: Around the World in Eighty Days
books.author: Jules Verne
books.description: English gentleman Phileas Fogg bets his fortune that he can circumnavigate the globe in eighty days, embarking on a thrilling race against time.

books.title: Journey to the Center of the Earth
books.author: Jules Verne
books.description: A German professor leads his nephew and a guide on a descent into an Icelandic volcano, discovering a subterranean world of prehistoric wonders.

books.title: The Time Machine
books.author: H.G. Wells
books.description: A Victorian inventor travels far into the future and discovers humanity has evolved into two distinct species—the gentle Eloi and the savage Morlocks.

books.title: The War of the Worlds
books.author: H.G. Wells
books.description: Martians invade Victorian England with devastating war machines, and one man struggles to survive the alien onslaught that brings civilization to its knees.

books.title: The Invisible Man
books.author: H.G. Wells
books.description: A scientist discovers how to make himself invisible, but the process drives him to madness and crime as the power corrupts him absolutely.

books.title: The Scarlet Letter
books.author: Nathaniel Hawthorne
books.description: In Puritan Boston, Hester Prynne is forced to wear a scarlet 'A' for adultery while the father of her illegitimate child conceals his guilt with devastating results.

books.title: The Red Badge of Courage
books.author: Stephen Crane
books.description: A young Union soldier confronts fear, cowardice, and the brutal reality of war during a Civil War battle, seeking to prove his courage to himself.

books.title: The Call of the Wild
books.author: Jack London
books.description: A domesticated dog named Buck is stolen and sold into service as a sled dog in the Klondike Gold Rush, gradually awakening to his primitive instincts.

books.title: White Fang
books.author: Jack London
books.description: A wild wolf-dog born in the Yukon Territory gradually becomes domesticated through kindness, the companion story to The Call of the Wild.

books.title: Kidnapped
books.author: Robert Louis Stevenson
books.description: Young David Balfour is kidnapped by his treacherous uncle and shipped off to sea, beginning a wild adventure through the Scottish Highlands.

books.title: The Jungle Book
books.author: Rudyard Kipling
books.description: A collection of stories centered on Mowgli, a boy raised by wolves in the Indian jungle, who must navigate the laws of nature and civilization.

books.title: The Importance of Being Earnest
books.author: Oscar Wilde
books.description: Two Victorian gentlemen maintain fictional alter egos named Ernest to escape social obligations, leading to farcical misunderstandings and a brilliant satire of upper-class society.

books.title: The Three Musketeers
books.author: Alexandre Dumas
books.description: Young Gascon d'Artagnan arrives in Paris and befriends three royal musketeers—Athos, Porthos, and Aramis—in swashbuckling adventures involving the scheming Cardinal Richelieu.

books.title: The Adventures of Pinocchio
books.author: Carlo Collodi
books.description: A wooden puppet carved by the old toymaker Geppetto longs to become a real boy, going on mischievous adventures and learning hard lessons about honesty.

books.title: Ethan Frome
books.author: Edith Wharton
books.description: A bleak tale of a Massachusetts farmer trapped in a loveless marriage who falls for his wife's cousin, leading to a desperate and tragic conclusion.

books.title: The Portrait of a Lady
books.author: Henry James
books.description: A spirited American woman inherits a fortune and travels to Europe seeking independence, only to be ensnared by a scheming expatriate and his manipulative companion.

books.title: The Turn of the Screw
books.author: Henry James
books.description: A governess becomes convinced that two orphaned children in her care are being influenced by the malevolent ghosts of former servants, in this ambiguous ghost story.

books.title: The Awakening
books.author: Kate Chopin
books.description: A married Creole woman vacationing in Louisiana gradually awakens to her own identity and desires, defying the social constraints placed on women of her era.

books.title: Candide
books.author: Voltaire
books.description: A naive young man raised on the philosophy that all is for the best is thrust into a world of catastrophe, cruelty, and absurdity in this biting satirical novella.

books.title: The Death of Ivan Ilyich
books.author: Leo Tolstoy
books.description: A successful judge falls terminally ill and is forced to confront the emptiness of his comfortable, conventional life as he faces death alone.

books.title: Notes from Underground
books.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
books.description: An unnamed, bitter narrator delivers a spiteful philosophical monologue from his St. Petersburg apartment in this proto-existentialist novella.

books.title: Heart of Darkness
books.author: Joseph Conrad
books.description: Sailor Charles Marlow recounts his journey up the Congo River to find the enigmatic ivory trader Kurtz, confronting imperialism and human evil in the African jungle.

books.title: The Secret Garden
books.author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
books.description: A spoiled orphan girl discovers a locked, abandoned garden at a gloomy Yorkshire manor, and the act of tending it transforms both the garden and herself.

books.title: The Phantom of the Opera
books.author: Gaston Leroux
books.description: A disfigured musical genius haunts the Paris Opera House from its cellars, obsessively tutoring a young soprano and committing crimes to keep her near him.

books.title: Kim
books.author: Rudyard Kipling
books.description: The orphaned son of an Irish soldier grows up street-smart in colonial India, eventually becoming embroiled in the Great Game of espionage between Britain and Russia.

books.title: Anne of Green Gables
books.author: L.M. Montgomery
books.description: An imaginative, red-haired orphan girl is mistakenly sent to a brother and sister on Prince Edward Island, winning them over with her irrepressible spirit.

books.title: A Connecticut Yankee in King Arthur's Court
books.author: Mark Twain
books.description: A 19th-century American factory worker is knocked unconscious and awakens in medieval England, where he uses his modern knowledge to become a powerful figure at Camelot.

books.title: The Prince and the Pauper
books.author: Mark Twain
books.description: A young Prince of Wales and a poor boy from the slums of London swap places, each discovering the harsh realities of the other's world in Tudor England.

books.title: Twenty Years After
books.author: Alexandre Dumas
books.description: D'Artagnan reunites the aging musketeers twenty years later as France is torn apart by civil war, and the companions must navigate shifting loyalties and old rivalries.
